review_evidence: README identifies the project goal as formalizing the spectral theorem through resolutions of the identity and reconstruction of bounded normal operators.
The primary modules Projections.lean, Resolutions.lean, and SpectralTheorem.lean form the mathematical development rather than tooling scaffolding.
A declaration scan finds 81 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations across the hydrated source; no source-local lossless exclusion was established.
summary: Retain SpectralThm, an active Lean mathematical development toward the spectral theorem for bounded normal operators on Hilbert spaces.
